data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Sun's up, waves are calling, let's go.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let's talk and walk this sunny day.  
Nice to meet you… Encantado  
Come join me… Ven conmigo  
Under the palm trees where we sway.

[Verse]
Feet in the sand, feeling the breeze,  
Waves are dancing, putting us at ease.  
Good vibes… Buenas vibras  
Under the sun's embrace.  
How's it going?… ¿Cómo te va?  
Tell me more… Cuéntame más  
About your life and your ways.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?  
Let's talk and walk this sunny day.  
Nice to meet you… Encantado  
Come join me… Ven conmigo  
Under the palm trees where we sway.

[Verse]
Where are you from?… ¿De dónde eres?  
Let's share our stories, make new memories.  
Thank you… Gracias  
For your smile and your time.  
What do you think?… ¿Qué opinas?  
About the ocean's rhyme?  
Can you repeat that?… ¿Puedes repetir?  
I want to hear your words again.

[Bridge]
What's your number?… ¿Cuál es tu número?
